visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a metal spoon lifting a translucent, brownish-glazed meat dumpling (Ba-wan) from a steaming container. The background shows stacks of ceramic plates. (2) A middle-aged man wearing a grey shirt, a red apron, and a black face mask stands indoors. He points toward a historical news article and old photos mounted on the wall. (3) The camera returns to food preparation, showing a hand adding a dollop of white garlic paste and then a squeeze of bright red chili sauce over the meat dumplings in a bowl. Forks pull the dumpling apart to reveal chunks of cooked meat inside. (4) The vendor is seen pouring a clear, hot broth from a large metal vat into a ceramic bowl containing residual sauce and meat bits. Chopped green scallions float on top of the steaming soup. (5) A bowl of 'Mi-gao' (sticky rice) is prepared, topped with dark braised pork, light brown fish floss, and sliced green pickled cucumbers. A pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a triangular piece of fried tofu. (6) The vendor places several finished dishes, including the meat dumplings, the rice, and a bowl of soup, onto a bright red outdoor table. (7) Shots of the shop's signage include a large yellow menu board with red text, a storefront sign reading '三塊厝肉圓嫂', and a red parking directional sign with white text and an arrow.
